name: @grey-ridge/elizaos-plugin-swap-gate
description: Pre-trade token-safety gate for Base trading agents (ElizaOS): honeypot, sellability, admin-control and liquidity-vs-size checks via Grey Ridge /gate/swap, paid inline with x402 USDC ($0.008/call). Call before every swap.
author: Grey Ridge Signals Group LLC

SWAP_GATE_PRIVATE_KEY.description: Hex private key of the agent's Base trading wallet; signs the x402 USDC payment ($0.008/call). Omit to use only the free preview path.

SWAP_GATE_NOTIONAL_USD.description: Default trade size in USD used for the liquidity/price-impact and sizing checks.

SWAP_GATE_MAX_BREAKEVEN_PCT.description: Skip a trade whose round-trip friction (entry+exit slippage) exceeds this percent.

SWAP_GATE_MAX_EXIT_SLIPPAGE_PCT.description: Skip a trade whose modelled exit slippage exceeds this percent.

SWAP_GATE_BASE_URL.description: Override the gate endpoint base URL (defaults to the hosted Grey Ridge Worker).
